idea-plugin.name: Review Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Review GitHub pull requests inside your IDE, with the whole codebase around them.

A diff page shows the lines that changed. To judge them you need the rest: the caller, the test, the config. Review Lens checks the pull request out in the window you already have open, so you read full files with every IDE tool, then puts you back exactly where you were.

  • Your work stays safe: uncommitted changes are parked in a named git stash and restored exactly on Exit.
  • Read the change in context: full files, read-only, with changes marked in the gutter and a diff one click away.
  • Track progress: ⭐ not viewed, ✅ viewed, 🔄 changed since viewed, synced with GitHub's Viewed checkboxes.
  • See the whole conversation: everyone's GitHub comments under their lines, a Comments tab listing them all, and replies in place.
  • Comment, then post once: inline drafts, replies, a summary and a verdict go to GitHub as a single review.
  • Review only what's new: a reviewed PR shows when new commits arrive, and one click reviews only those.
  • Works offline: without GitHub it lists branches instead, and viewed ticks sync later.

Requires git and the GitHub CLI signed in (gh auth login). Open the Review tool window, or click Review PR… in the toolbar.

User guide · Source · Issues
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.3

  • Everyone's review threads in the file you are reading: open ones with the whole conversation, resolved ones folded to a line, outdated ones counted above the first line.
  • A Comments tab lists every thread and draft on the PR, filtered by open, yours or pending; click one to jump to its line.
  • Reply to an open thread right there; replies go out with your review. Finish review first checks GitHub, and says when a thread you replied to was resolved meanwhile.
  • The comment box grows as you type, ⌘↩ / Ctrl+Enter adds the comment, Esc cancels, and a background refresh no longer takes your typing focus. Opening another box keeps the text you haven't added.
  • A PR you reviewed shows "New commits since your review" when someone pushes; opening it picks only those commits and the button reads "Review new commits".
  • No deprecated platform APIs on 2026.1 through 2026.3.

0.1.2

  • Ready for upcoming IDE versions: no longer uses an API JetBrains has scheduled for removal, and no longer builds against deprecated or experimental platform APIs it never needed.
  • File / Diff switching responds to every click, and always highlights the view you are on.
  • Finish review can mark a PR reviewed without posting, and every finish returns you to the pull request list, ready for the next one.
  • A fuller plugin page: features, requirements and links to the user guide.

0.1.1

  • First release: review a pull request in the window you already have open, with your work parked and restored, a viewed checklist synced with GitHub, inline comments posted as one review, and blame on the caret line.
